definitionZh: 溢出 CSS 的短手属性设定了在元素的粘贴框(溢出流)中与水平和/或垂直方向不匹配时所需的行为.
sourceDefinition: The overflow CSS shorthand property sets the desired behavior when content does not fit in the element's padding box (overflows) in the horizontal and/or vertical direction.

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The overflow CSS shorthand property sets the desired behavior when content does not fit in the element's padding box (overflows) in the horizontal and/or vertical direction.
